name: Rezonator
source:
In the maelstrom of other people's feelings, can you see even a drop of yourself?
It's really cool to be able to empathize. But if you resonate with everyone around you, is there anything left in you? 

"Resonator" tells a story about feelings of confusion, the hopelessness one drives themself into, about questions, separation, and their own boundaries. Where exactly the story will lead you depends on you, your rationality and your sense of justice - let's see which is stronger.

[translated from [url=https://danadelion.itch.io/resonator]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在别人感情的漩涡中，你还能看到哪怕一滴自己吗？
能够产生同理心真是太好了。但如果你和周围的每个人都产生共鸣，你身上还剩下什么吗？

《共鸣器》讲述了一个关于困惑感、让自己陷入绝望、关于问题、分离和自我界限的故事。故事到底会把你引向何方取决于你、你的理性和你的正义感——让我们看看哪个更强。

[译自[url=https://danadelion.itch.io/resonator]itch.io[/url]]
